name: Parameters
descr: The parameters of the goods: the commercial properties the prices are built of - warranty, delivery, a margin of its own - and the values each one takes, every value with the sum it carries and the currency of that sum. Not what a buyer reads about the goods: that is the characteristics, and the Attributes tool keeps them.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the parameters together with all their values - two tables. The option rows standing on parameters and on values come with CmdListFull.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the parameters, their values and the option rows standing on both - four tables in one answer.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a parameter at the end of the list. fixed_set keeps the goods to the values of its list and nothing of their own; custom_sum lets the sum be changed on the goods.

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key, unique among the parameters

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the parameter

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of PARAM_KIND_KEY

params.name: fixed_set
params.descr: true - the goods take only the values of its list, nothing of their own

params.name: custom_sum
params.descr: true - the sum of a value may be changed on the goods

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of parameters, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the parameter, or several of them

params.name: fixed_set
params.descr: true - the goods take only the values of its list, nothing of their own

params.name: custom_sum

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes parameters by id, with their values and the links of the goods to them. The first call counts what goes, the second one does it; the prices built on those sums change.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the parameter, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays the list of the parameters in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdValueAdd
commands.descr: Adds a value to a parameter, at the end of its list.

params.name: param_id
params.descr: id of the parameter the value belongs to

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key, unique among the values of this parameter

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the value

params.name: set_sum
params.descr: the sum this value carries

params.name: sum_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency of that sum

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list of its parameter; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on parameters: one row of param_key_set on every parameter named. The options are declared in the registry of the additional options, place param.

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the value written by hand, when the option keeps no list
